name: Vanya
self_text: Hi, I'm Vanya! I'm a Spanish guy in my late 20s. When I'm not gaming on my PC, I love fermenting my own hot sauce because I really enjoy the chemistry and the kick of a good brew. These days it's all Hollow Lantern for me, and I'm mostly into ranked matches. Regarding coaching, there is no coaching. As for my schedule, most weeks I can do Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either on Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings. I'd strongly prefer that you are into ranked matches, though it's not a requirement. It would be a small bonus if you are into Hollow Lantern or Tidewatch.
